name: National University of Medical Sciences (NUMS)
_note: Closing = lowest aggregate in the newest NUMS selection list published for each affiliated private college (MBBS: Sixth Selection / Upgradation List, 27 Jan 2026; QIMS Baluchistan-domicile list 'January 19, 2026'; BDS: Fourth Selection List, 13 Feb 2026). Lists are cumulative (sorted, S No 1..n); min checked by script against every PDF on 31 Oct 2026. NUMS does not say these were the last lists, so the list is 'Latest published'. Aggregate = PM&DC formula (50% MDCAT, 40% FSc, 10% Matric), same as the UHS calculator. PDFs (with names) stay in sources/nums/, never in the repo. Index pages: https://numspak.edu.pk/news-detail/merit-lists-of-candidates-for-admission-in-private-sector-affiliated-medical-colleges-for-mbbs-open-merit-session-2025-26 and https://numspak.edu.pk/news-detail/merit-lists-of-candidates-for-admission-in-private-sector-affiliated-dental-colleges-for-bds-open-merit-session-2025-26
